blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on Monday, Nov. 9, administered the oath of office to Chief Justice Rodil Zalameda. In a ceremony at Malacañang, Marcos formalized Zalameda’s appointment as the country’s 28th chief justice, succeeding Alexander Gesmundo. READ: Associate Justice Rodil Zalameda is new chief justice Gesmundo reached the mandatory retirement age of 70 on Nov. 6, the same day Zalameda first took his oath of office before all 15 members of the Supreme Court en banc. Zalameda authored the Supreme Court decision acquitting former first lady Imelda Marcos of seven counts of graft, reversing a November 2018 Sandiganbayan […]...
